pipeline/sanskrit_gold.py.role: the fixed gold control (5601 exemplars, tradition-tagged)

pipeline/validate_benchmark.py.role: THE meta-eval: Kendall's tau of each metric vs judge

tools/sanskrit_benchmark.py.role: the per-school × per-period leaderboard + cost router

pipeline/frontier_gold.py.role: imports + loads the frontier benchmark datasets (Sāmayik 2417, Itihāsa 11721) as external gold for the meta-eval

agent/run.py.role: the agent-run orchestrator: any lab step (validate/eval/hypothesis/proof/report/watchdog), kanban-aware, logs every run
agent/run.py.validator: run: python3 agent/run.py --step proof --source x --candidate y

agent/watchdog.py.role: the autonomous watchdog: validate→hypothesize→report cycle, logged, box-safe

pipeline/run_recorder.py.role: content-addressed run records + nanopublication triples (provenance ledger)

agent/audit.py.role: the golden-file audit (recompute on fixed gold, fail on mismatch) — the executable ONE RULE

agent/paper_build.py.role: number-inject paper build (metrics from run records → .tex → PDF)

pipeline/sanskrit_texts.py.role: the progressive-difficulty source: 254 DCS/GRETIL texts tagged by school/tier/period + specialist-term density

pipeline/benchmark_registry.py.role: the legitimate content-addressed, versioned benchmark registry (lineage + decontamination audit)

pipeline/benchmark_runner.py.role: run the benchmark: dealradar picks model per tier → hermes translates → Pāṭala proof gate → content-addressed result

agent/trace.py.role: the central run+experiment trace — query every hermes run/experiment/log in one command

agent/verify.py.role: the one-command verification gate: proof gate + gold anti-hallucination + content-addressed record
agent/verify.py.validator: run: python3 agent/verify.py --source x --candidate y --gold z

agent/ramwatch.py.role: the RAM/CPU budget watchdog — check free/load before + during heavy jobs to prevent OOM crashes

pipeline/checkpoint.py.role: the vision→checkpoint engine: decompose a goal into a falsifiable checkpoint DAG; only a passed gate marks done (autonomous goal-hitting)

pipeline/renderer.py.role: re-render a passage into N candidate translations; keep the equally-valid set (proof gate + semantic threshold)

pipeline/finetune_builder.py.role: build fine-tuning register-pair data (plain/precise) from gold + re-renders, LoRA-ready

pipeline/tree_search.py.role: metric-grounded tree search (AIDE mechanism) — every node scored by a REAL computed metric on fixed gold, best-first expansion; the autonomous strategy loop

agent/memory.py.role: the deterministic temporal memory (DML) — records/query agent decisions with provenance + drift; anti-regression

pipeline/schemas.py.role: the canonical schema contracts (incl. PROOF_EVIDENCE) + validators

agent/validate_data.py.role: the strict data gate: validate every data file against its schema (wired into check.py --data)

pipeline/data_import.py.role: import + catalog the frontier datasets (MITRA cross-canon triangulation, streamed)

pipeline/sanskrit_mqm.py.role: Sanskrit MQM taxonomy + controlled bad-translation challenge-set generator

agent/annotation.py.role: the human MQM gold annotation contract + exporter + validator (SaReward + SaError)

pipeline/proof_carrying.py.role: the proof-carrying translation evidence artifact (visionadvice §12) — immutable, inspectable

pipeline/confidence.py.role: the confidence feature-vector + multidimensional proof score (§7,§20) — CPU features computed, neural marked

pipeline/triangulation.py.role: cross-canon (Tibetan/Chinese) triangulation evidence channel (§3,§13) via MITRA

agent/challenge_verify.py.role: verify every challenge-set T- < T+ on semantic fidelity (the N1 SaQE competence gate)

agent/challenge_verify_batch.sh.role: run the full N1 T-<T+ challenge competence gate as one box-safe backgrounded job

agent/plan_audit.py.role: reconcile a DEV-PLAN claim to real files + run the retirement gates
